answer: Stake a deposit before reviewing. Split the jury into three auditors who never see each other's scores, then re-grade one submission in twenty as a spot check. If the spot check disagrees with the panel, the outlier loses its deposit and a fresh panel reads the answer. Reviewers who stop working lose standing every epoch, so seats go to the ones still active. The timber is the deposit, the dune is a farm that shifts shape between epochs, the willow is the reviewer who bends with the spot check. A thousand fake reviewers need a thousand deposits at risk.
